what: The form base key -> read-lists -> answer was written at least five times (the design doc counted four; `hir_def::deps::slot` is a fifth, and the domains `serve request certificate slot`, `kernel shape slot`, `crate surface slot` and `test history slot` look like more). Two bounds (4 and 4096), three answer-key rules (by slot, by names and values, by parts), three list encodings, and the four-slot ones never store a fifth list of a base.
cost: each new user copied the nearest one and its defect; one lane to make the one type
cause: no shared crate below hir-def and blaze-usercode held the form, so each crate that needed it wrote it beside its store adapter
prevention: crates/blaze-record is the one home; after the ports, ban a `slot(key, n)` key derivation outside it (a domains.rs check: a domain ending in `slot` or `shape` outside blaze-record fails)
fix: blaze-record written (uncompiled at the time of this row); ports of goal_store and body_store next
